subject: vision model training data
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded LVT and Flock Safety and your company has come up in
a few conversations.

We work with smart camera and surveillance CCTV companies that are also
building their VLM. A common challenge they face is increasing labelling
throughput as real-world footages and edge cases outgrow open source
tooling.

We're seeing a trend of teams shifting from multi-tool stack (CVAT, Voxel
51, Segments + Services) to Encord, consolidating annotation, QA, and model
evaluation.

Would love to get your thoughts if you are open to a quick chat next week .

subject: multimodal AI
text:

you face a challenge when real-world training data outgrows open source

30-min next week.
